biomes.description: Meadow grass, muted olive-green tufts, local grey-brown earth and modest neutral gravel. No Boreal moss blanket.
Low olive moss, sparse forest grass, cool grey granite pebbles, gently worn mineral ground. No trees.
Short upland meadow grass between grey weathered bedrock and compacted pale gravel, small natural stones.
Dry golden grasses and dusty ochre-brown earth, small warm rocks and compacted neutral grit.
Dark volcanic pebbles and weathered basalt with sparse hardy olive vegetation, cooled dry solid ground, no glowing lava.
Pale coastal gravel, sandy stony earth and short coastal grass with a subtle salt-worn edge. Dry island footing, no surrounding water ring.
Lush varied green low grass, damp grey-brown earth and small mixed rocks, natural terrestrial footing.
Compacted warm desert sand, windblown fine grit and scattered sun-bleached small stones, sparse to no vegetation.
Small dry exposed coastal-rock footing, pale salt-weathered rock and grey grit, minimal hardy coastal grass. No invented floating platform or submerged building.
Compacted pale snow and blue-grey frost over gritty stone, rough irregular icy margin, no huge icebergs.
Dry cooled charcoal basalt and dark ash, solid heat-weathered footing, a few tiny reddish mineral seams, no lava pond or molten foundation.
Desaturated grey-brown regolith dust, small angular stones and crater-worn grit. No vegetation or snow.
